summary: Tests written before the build for the 'My open enquiries' Lead list view. Apex: MyOpenEnquiriesListViewTest (visible to Recruitment Officer, hidden from Minimum Access). Playwright: tests/e2e/specs/20-my-open-enquiries.spec.ts, one test per AC in the recruitment-officer project, with synthetic Leads seeded and removed through sf (tests/e2e/support/org.ts). All are expected to fail until force-app/main/default/objects/Lead/listViews/My_open_enquiries.listView-meta.xml exists.

acceptanceCriteria.evidence: MyOpenEnquiriesListViewTest.shouldShowListViewToRecruitmentOfficer; Playwright '#20 AC1: Leads tab offers the "My open enquiries" list view'

Playwright '#20 AC2: shows only my unconverted Leads with the agreed columns' (own open Lead shown; Lead owned by another user and a converted Lead of the persona hidden; columns Name, Company, Lead Source, Lead Source Detail, Lead Status, Created Date in that order)

MyOpenEnquiriesListViewTest.shouldHideListViewFromPersonaOutsideGroup (denial); Playwright '#20 AC3: list view is shared only with the persona public group' (retrieves the deployed list view and asserts sharedTo is only group Persona_Recruitment_Officer, and the persona is a member and sees it)

notes: Spec file named tests/e2e/specs/20-my-open-enquiries.spec.ts per the test-writer role (<issue>-<slug>), not my-open-enquiries.spec.ts as in the plan.

Playwright setup uses sf as the org's CLI user: SF_DATA_ORG (alias) if set, otherwise the CLI default target org. The workflows pass --target-org explicitly (agent / pr / qa-admin) and do not set a default; if seeding fails with no target org, the harness needs SF_DATA_ORG exported (a .github change for a person, PIPE-08).
AC2 'Status' is rendered by Lightning as 'Lead Status'; the test accepts either and the PR should note it.
Apex ListView query is assumed visible without SeeAllData (plan fallback: if not, drop the two Apex methods and record why; Playwright then carries AC1 and AC3).
No bulk Apex test: the change adds no Apex, trigger or batch path (TST-03 bulk applies to those).
Denial limitation from the plan stands: MINIMUM_ACCESS has no Lead access, so it cannot separate 'not in group' from 'no Lead access'.
